row.Finding: PETG generally performs better outdoors than PLA, offering improved resistance to UV, moisture, and heat. However, prolonged, permanent outdoor exposure can still cause gradual fading or embrittlement over time.
row.Exposure / conditions: Exact-product maker claim or exclusion, not a qualified service test or selection pass. Raw-material certification does not certify a printed article. Outdoor lifetime/protocol, exposure agents/concentrations/duration and printed specimen/test conditions are unstated unless quoted. An independent-test claim is retained as a maker claim; underlying report not retrieved. Comparisons retain their named counterpart; no values transferred to adjacent grades.
